seoTitle: robots.txt Minifier: Remove Comments and Duplicates
metaDescription: Shrink a robots.txt without changing what crawlers do: strip comments and blank lines, drop duplicate rules, merge identical groups. Free.
intro: Produces a compact robots.txt that behaves the same: no comments, no blank lines, no duplicate rules and merged groups.
why:
If your robots.txt is approaching the size limit or you serve it at scale, comments and repeated rules are dead weight. Rewriting by hand risks changing behaviour.

The minifier removes only what is safe: comments, blank lines, exact duplicate rules, and merges groups with identical user-agent sets. It deliberately keeps rules that look redundant, because their effect can depend on Allow rules. It shows the bytes saved.
howTo: Test key URLs on the new file before publishing.

faq.q: Why is a blank Disallow added?
faq.a: An empty group would otherwise merge into the next one, so an empty Disallow keeps it separate.
Rarely. It matters near the size limit.
